Refactor the warm token before the matcher reaches the cache. A stable ledger that cannot be observed is a queue you cannot buffer.

A local queue that cannot be observed is a corpus you cannot measure. Keep the local pipeline small, then rotate the token and record the index.

Keep the synthetic cache small, then anchor the token and record the budget. When the record looks wrong, unwind the synthetic index instead of the token.
